title: bb_edit: cross-file caller freshness (fail loud, no silent partial)

checks.name: fresh caller: call site renamed
checks.detail:
import { renamedTarget } from "./target"
export function caller(): number { return renamedTarget() }

checks.name: shrunk caller file aborts (no silent skip) [negative: not fresh]
shrunk caller: declaration NOT renamed (no partial)
grown caller file aborts [negative: not fresh]
missing caller file aborts [negative: not fresh]
one stale caller among several aborts the whole refactor [negative: not fresh]
multi: fresh caller1 NOT renamed (no partial across files)
checks.detail:
import { target } from "./target"
export function caller1(): number { return target() }

checks.name: out-of-bounds caller span aborts (never silently clamped/skipped) [negative: caller span out of bounds]

decisions.freshnessSource: brain_file.file_hash (SHA-256 16-hex) vs on-disk content, checked via assertFreshFiles on every caller fileId before any rename
decisions.spanGuard: each caller byte span is validated to lie inside the current file; a corrupt/out-of-bounds span throws instead of being silently clamped/skipped
decisions.atomicAbort: planEdit resolves the full plan (freshness + spans) before executeEdit writes anything, so a stale caller aborts with zero writes

limitations: allowStaleIndex only bypasses the declaration file's freshness gate; caller freshness is always enforced (safer, never a silent partial rename).
Cross-file import specifiers are not renamed (imports live in brain_import, not calls/references) — unchanged from E2, tracked separately.
